svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-14
svg.desc: Headless stress-run behavior and cursor fallback.
svg.text: 2026-07-14 - Headless stress-run behavior
main | 3 commits: 871d6db, 049e9d6, c9046cf
Daily job
Make automated NullRHI runs behave more like a real player session.
AutoTest runtime, agents, target-data, controller helpers, editor launch, and XML scenario changed.
BEFORE
Synthetic headless behavior
Auto-run did not resemble a player.
Movement and skill use were too regular.
No real cursor existed in NullRHI.
Target acquisition could fail for environment reasons.
AFTER
Reusable stress behavior with explicit fallback
NullRHI auto-run adds movement timing and random skill use.
Target-data acquisition receives a cursor fallback when no mouse exists.
Test XML is reduced to a reusable auto-run scenario.
Stale plugin DocsURL configuration is cleared.
Guard: no cursor is an environment constraint, not automatically an ability failure.
Important guard
Keep target-data fallback explicit.
Do not hide real targeting failures behind a
generic headless success.
Validation / newcomer path
Read AutoTest agent behavior with target-data code.
The runner simulates a client, but the fallback is
still a named part of the test contract.
